<script>
  //console.log('product-tab')
  const targetNode = document.querySelector('.productView-description');
  let isElementAppended = false;

  function appendScript() {
    // Create a new script element
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = "{{cdn 'assets/js/theme/custom/accordion.js'}}";
    script.type = "module";

    // Append the script to the document body or any other appropriate location
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  }

  //$(document).ready(function() {
  tabScript()
  function tabScript() {
    $('[data-acctabid]').on('click', function () {
      let tabName = $(this).data('acctabid');
      let tabContent = $(`#${tabName}`)
      //console.log('tabName ',tabName,'tabcontent ', tabContent)
      $('.pdp-content-body').removeClass('is-active')
      $(tabContent).toggleClass('is-active')
      $(this).toggleClass('is-active')
    })
  }
  //});

  // Run appendScript() after a certain timeout
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!isElementAppended) {
      appendScript();
      if ($('[data-acctabid="tab-schematic"]').length == 1 && $('[data-acctabid="tab-wear-parts"]').length == 1) {
        $('[data-acctabid="tab-schematic"]').remove()
        $('[data-tabcon="tab-schematic"]').remove()
      }
    }
  }, 1000); // Adjust the timeout duration as needed


</script>
